Descriptions.ShortDescription: Beta PSF Guard Director with bounded local target scheduling.
Descriptions.LongDescription: Experimental Director with shared-core target scheduling, ranked priorities and Moon avoidance. Reports equipment and requests work automatically. Recovers interrupted assignments using current image counts while preserving images and history. Requires a PSF Guard server with automatic session recovery support, plus explicit acquisition, safety and enclosure policies. Supports live or deferred check-ins, native NINA centering, rotation, autofocus, guiding, dithering and meridian flips, plus custom sequence hooks. Real-sky full-night acceptance remains open. Do not use for unattended imaging. Director is separate from PSF Guard Sync and does not replace or change Sync.
